name: Hanamiya Suzuka
source:
She is from an old noble family.

She is a beautiful and bewitching woman with a clear-cut personality and a flamboyant appearance.

She even uses her own daughter as a tool to achieve her desires. She has a relationship with Ryosuke and tries to win him over, but...
